versions.subject: rule: abuse of permissions to hide services
versions.detection:
sc:
  Image|endswith: '\sc.exe'
cli:
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - 'sdset'
    - 'DCLCWPDTSD'
condition: sc and cli
